integrity: Standalone proof and reproducible finite verifier included; finite tests supplement the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-letter alphabet, exactly one surplus zero, all k>=1. The arithmetic 01 statistic counts scattered pairs; published unrefined universality counts are not claimed new. An equivalent unindexed q-refinement remains possible.
title: A sharp \(01\)-subsequence enumerator for near-shortest binary universal words
